verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms that register.dpma.de serves a real robots.txt (HTTP 200) with explicit directives: "Disallow: /" for all agents plus enumerated Allow paths. An agent can therefore tell what it may read before fetching anything. Its restrictiveness does not change that the file exists and is meaningful. Missing for 10: no evidence of a robots.txt on the main www.dpma.de host or other service hosts (e.g., DEPATISnet), the Allow paths are ambiguous about which surfaces are permitted, and nothing beyond a single probe corroborates it.
